name: 08-crlf-quirk
description: Quirk kept for parity: with CRLF endings the app/title lines fail (JS "(.+)$" does not match the trailing \r), so the first app/title line is unreadable. Other lines tolerate the \r.
input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: w
    app: settings
    title: Wi-Fi
    widgets:
      - {type: wifi, cs: 4, rs: 2}
